title.zh: 两次世界大战与大屠杀

clips.send: The Marco Polo Bridge Incident (七七事变). 7 July 1937. Japanese troops attacked Chinese forces at the Marco Polo Bridge (卢沟桥) near Beijing. China began its nationwide War of Resistance (全民族抗战) — years before the war in Europe started. Japan had already seized Northeast China in 1931 (the 18 September Incident), the start of China’s 14-year war.

clips.send: Sarajevo. The heir to Austria-Hungary was shot near the Latin Bridge here. Within weeks the alliances pulled Europe into World War I.

clips.send: Pearl Harbor. Japan’s surprise air attack sank or damaged many US warships, and the next day the USA entered the war. The USS Arizona Memorial floats above the sunken ship.

clips.send: Neuve Chapelle. Many soldiers from India fought in this early trench battle. A memorial here remembers the Indian soldiers who died on the Western Front.

clips.send: 珍珠港。日本的突然空袭击沉、击伤了许多美国军舰，第二天美国参战。“亚利桑那号”纪念馆就建在沉船的上方。

clips.send: 新沙佩勒。很多印度士兵参加了这场早期的堑壕战。这里的纪念碑纪念在西线阵亡的印度士兵。

clips.send: 七七事变（卢沟桥事变）。1937年7月7日。日军在北平（今北京）附近的卢沟桥向中国守军发动进攻。中国开始了全民族抗战——比欧洲战争的爆发早了两年。早在1931年，日本就发动九一八事变侵占中国东北，这是中国十四年抗战的开端。

clips.send: 萨拉热窝。奥匈帝国皇位继承人在这里的拉丁桥附近遇刺。几周之内，各国结成的同盟把欧洲拖入了第一次世界大战。

clips.send: 诺曼底。1066年，威廉公爵从这里出发征服了英格兰。诺曼底登陆那天，约15.6万盟军在这里的海滩登陆，解放法国。
